_comment: Site identity. The brand does not translate — only the tagline and the copy do. One place to change the name, the canonical URL and the repository. `url` is the canonical home: it must be the copy that is actually current. `fallbackUrl` is the other home.
name: Real Local Cost

tagline.en: What digital services actually cost, where you live, as a share of what people earn there.
tagline.fr: Ce que les services numériques coûtent vraiment, chez vous, au regard de ce que les gens y gagnent.
tagline.ar: كم تكلّف الخدمات الرقمية فعلياً في بلدك، مقارنةً بما يكسبه الناس فيه.

description.en: Netflix, Spotify and Apple TV+ priced in every market's own currency, then divided by what people earn there — so the number means the same thing everywhere.
description.fr: Netflix, Spotify et Apple TV+ tarifés dans la devise de chaque marché, puis divisés par ce que les gens y gagnent — pour que le chiffre signifie la même chose partout.
description.ar: نتفليكس وسبوتيفاي وآبل تي في ب 것으로 تسعّر في عملة كل سوق، ثم تُقسَم على ما يكسبه الناس هناك — ليصبح الرقم يعني الشيء نفسه في كل مكان.

canonicalNote: The Cloudflare copy (reallocalcost.pages.dev) is the nicer domain, but it only updates once a Cloudflare API token is added as the repo secret CF_WRANGLER_CONFIG... actually CF_CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN. Until then the GitHub Pages copy is the one that is current, so it is the canonical.
